content.short: DODO is a DEX enabling cross-chain trading of fungible and non-fungible tokens.
content.description: Launched in August 2020, DODO is a decentralized exchange and on-chain liquidity provider. It uses a proactive market maker (PMM) pricing model to source accurate market prices for crypto assets. The PMM approach is claimed to offer better liquidity and price stability than traditional automated market makers (AMMs). DODO’s native token operates on Ethereum as an ERC-20 asset, and the protocol supports the trading of a wide range of crypto assets, including NFTs, across multiple blockchains.
